title: An improvement bound on a problem of Picasarri-Arrieta and Rambaud
summary: Let $k$ and $\ell$ be positive integers. A cycle with two blocks $C(k,\ell)$ is a digraph consisting of two internally vertex disjoint directed paths of lengths $k$ and $\ell$ with the same initial vertex and terminal vertex. Picasarri-Arrieta and Rambaud (European J. Combin., 2024) proved that for any $k\geq 2$, every digraph of minimum out-degree at least two and girth at least $8k-6$ contains a subdivision of $C(k,k)$.
